title: S119 later notes: landing status text, cleanup-failed rows, fix-round allowlist

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S119 relay (run-20261026-131324-6dbc, landed b7bc308), not fixed in that slice:
- Approve status text should say what is happening, for example "landing S22: pending".
- docs/dashboard.md:482 wording (flagged in round 1).
- A second approval after a landing fix round writes the human-checks note twice.
- Not verified: whether the registry's implementer allowlist permits git add, git commit and slicer render in the worktree for a landing fix round.
- The "c finishes the cleanup" detail shows even when the merge state is unknown, and `c` then refuses (`internal/daemon/landed.go:132`; low).
- The cleanup-failed reason is clipped to one dim line; no view shows it in full.
- Recent could read "landed, cleanup failed" for a cleanup-failed run.
- Approve is one key on the card and asks first on Overview; adj 98 (ui.confirm) still says one key until the owner supersedes it (owner said they will, 2026-10-26).
The cleanup key failing on a worktree that is already gone is filed on S95.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Triage first. Spec each kept note with a failing test before building; check the allowlist question by reading the registry and reporting before any change.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
